audit_phase: Phase 10 — B4 Evaluation Integrity Audit and Error Analysis

task1_evaluation_integrity.porch_recall_discrepancy_explanation: Under Canonical_Original_134, the defective 1.0x1.0 box on oi_ext_test_0106 artificially matched a broad porch prediction ([0.5, 0.324, 1.0, 0.647], conf=0.245) with IoU=0.647 >= 0.50, generating a True Positive at the global F1 threshold. Under Canonical_Corrected_134, Proposal A (area 6.3%) has IoU=0.097 with that prediction, making it a False Positive. The only remaining instance (oi_ext_test_0113) was localized accurately (IoU=0.85) but had confidence 0.0158, falling below the global F1 operating threshold (~0.25). Thus, True Positives = 0 at that threshold, yielding Recall=0.0000, despite AP50 across the PR curve reaching 0.0990.

task2_provenance_audit.source_split_reuse_finding: 82 images originally in Google Open Images V7 official test split and 28 from validation were reassigned into RoomAI training data. While internal RoomAI splits are strictly leak-free, B4 cannot be benchmarked against the standard external Open Images V7 test set without train-set contamination.
task2_provenance_audit.curated_test_set_independence: The 20 new curated test scenes (28 instances) are distinct architectural scenes not in RoomAI train or val. However, sample size is small, carrying a +/- 3.57% statistical step per detection.

task3_latency_audit.anomaly_root_cause: The warm-up loop only ran on the first 10 images (sample_images[:10]). B2 was the first model evaluated, meaning images 10-49 were read from disk for the first time during B2's timing loop. Windows file system cache misses caused 110-135 ms disk I/O spikes on 13 images. B3 and B4 were evaluated subsequent to B2 and benefited from an already-warm Windows file system cache.
task3_latency_audit.finding: B2 p95 latency is 37.27 ms when properly warmed, fully consistent with B3 and B4.

task4_validation_error_analysis.porch_finding: 66.7% of validation porch errors have correct spatial localization (IoU >= 0.50, mean IoU 0.76) but confidence scores between 0.02 and 0.16. Tuning threshold from 0.25 to 0.17 triples porch recall on validation data.

task5_recommendation.selected_recommendation: B. Conduct a controlled threshold/calibration experiment.

rejected_options.A_additional_data: Premature. Model B4 already localizes 66.7% of missed validation porches with IoU >= 0.50. Adding more raw data without resolving confidence miscalibration will not fix threshold suppression.
rejected_options.C_higher_resolution_b5: Premature. While thin objects would benefit from 800px/1024px, the primary rare-class failure mode on porch is confidence calibration, which should be stabilized first.
rejected_options.D_repair_pipeline: Unnecessary. Internal split integrity is verified zero-leakage, and the evaluation metrics accurately reflect standard COCO protocol when per-class thresholds are accounted for.

next_acceptance_criteria: Calibrate per-class operating thresholds on validation data (porch=0.17, window=0.46, roof=0.44).
Verify porch recall >= 0.35 and F1 >= 0.38 at calibrated threshold on validation data.
Deploy fully warmed 50-image latency benchmark verifying median <= 30 ms and p95 <= 45 ms.
Confirm zero regression on all 82 unit tests.
